verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several self-hosting paths for GitLab: the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart or Operator for cloud-native installs, and self-compiling from source. Recommended scaling configurations are also documented. A community user confirms running a private instance at work. Missing for 10: evidence that the AI/agent features (Duo Agent Platform) run on self-managed instances, and in-depth independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.
